title: stipa clausa subsp. matritensis
intro: Stipa clausa subsp. matritensis, commonly known as Spanish Needle Grass, is a perennial grass species native to the Iberian Peninsula and North Africa. This plant is valued for its traditional use in folk medicine, where it is believed to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of S. clausa subsp. matritensis include expectorant and emollient properties, making it useful in treating coughs and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety for human consumption.
